title: LA City General Fund postings, December 2025 vs December 2024

attempts.text: The City of Los Angeles General Fund posted a $104.6 million increase from December 2024 to December 2025, marking a significant increase in expenditures compared to the previous year. This increase is attributed to the increase in non-Departmental - General spending, which was $177.9 million in December 2025, up from $62.3 million in December 2024. The increase in Fire spending, which was $79.0 million in December 2025, is also notable, marking a decrease from $88.9 million in December 2024. The increase in non-Departmental - Liability Claims spending, which was $12.6 million in December 2025, is also significant, up from $19.8 million in December 2024. The increase in non-Departmental - Petroleum Products spending, which was $3.4 million in December 2025, is also notable, up from $0.0 million in December 2024. The increase in non-Departmental - General City Purposes spending, which was $14.5 million in December 2025, is also significant, up from $11.6 million in December 2024.

final_text: General Fund postings were $737.8m in December 2025, up 16.5% from $633.2m in December 2024. Year-to-date postings were $4.23bn, up 4.4%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - General increased by $115.6m; Fire decreased by $9.9m; Non-Departmental - Liability Claims decreased by $7.2m.
